name: provider-switch
description: Switch Claude Code between Claude and the models of OpenAI-compatible providers (IETI Agents Proxy, DeepSeek, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama...) from a pane

proxyUrl.title: Proxy URL
proxyUrl.description: Base URL of one OpenAI-compatible provider, shown as Configured, e.g. https://agents.example.com (a URL with no path gets /v1). More providers can be added in the pane.

apiKey.title: Proxy API key
apiKey.description: API key for the Configured provider (optional). Kept in secure storage.
